headline: The Blind Spot Beneath Our Cities
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 340" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif">
  <rect width="500" height="340" fill="#e8f4ec"/>
  <ellipse cx="250" cy="165" rx="135" ry="95" fill="none" stroke="#1a7a3a" stroke-width="8"/>
  <ellipse cx="250" cy="165" rx="100" ry="62" fill="none" stroke="#d1e7d6" stroke-width="4"/>
  <text x="250" y="40" text-anchor="middle" fill="#64748b" font-size="14" font-weight="600">Periodic survey vs. continuous movement</text>
  <!-- manual inspection points (green) -->
  <g fill="#1a7a3a">
    <circle cx="135" cy="165" r="8"/><circle cx="250" cy="70" r="8"/>
    <circle cx="365" cy="165" r="8"/><circle cx="250" cy="260" r="8"/>
  </g>
  <!-- deformation gap between two survey points (amber) -->
  <path d="M315 120 Q345 175 315 230" fill="none" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="5" stroke-dasharray="2 6"/>
  <circle cx="345" cy="175" r="11" fill="#d97706"/>
  <text x="345" y="205" text-anchor="middle" fill="#d97706" font-size="13" font-weight="700">crack</text>
  <text x="250" y="312" text-anchor="middle" fill="#64748b" font-size="13">Inspection gap = undetected drift</text>
</svg>

headline: The EDGE Sensor Mesh
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 340" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif">
  <rect width="500" height="340" fill="#e8f4ec"/>
  <text x="250" y="34" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e293b" font-size="15" font-weight="700">Sensor mesh → live dashboard</text>
  <!-- sensor nodes -->
  <g font-size="11" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="700">
    <rect x="20" y="70" width="120" height="44" rx="8" fill="#1a7a3a"/><text x="80" y="97" text-anchor="middle">Fibre-Optic</text>
    <rect x="20" y="148" width="120" height="44" rx="8" fill="#1a7a3a"/><text x="80" y="175" text-anchor="middle">Robotic TS</text>
    <rect x="20" y="226" width="120" height="44" rx="8" fill="#1a7a3a"/><text x="80" y="253" text-anchor="middle">IoT Inclino.</text>
  </g>
  <!-- arrows -->
  <g stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="4" fill="none" marker-end="url(#ar)">
    <line x1="145" y1="92" x2="205" y2="130"/><line x1="145" y1="170" x2="205" y2="160"/><line x1="145" y1="248" x2="205" y2="190"/>

  <line x1="303" y1="160" x2="360" y2="160" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#ar)"/>
  <!-- dashboard -->
  <rect x="366" y="112" width="118" height="96" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a7a3a" stroke-width="3"/>
  <text x="425" y="138" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e293b" font-size="12" font-weight="700">Live Dashboard</text>
  <rect x="380" y="150" width="90" height="10" rx="3" fill="#d1e7d6"/>
  <rect x="380" y="166" width="64" height="10" rx="3" fill="#d1e7d6"/>
  <circle cx="468" cy="190" r="9" fill="#d97706"/>

  <text x="250" y="300" text-anchor="middle" fill="#64748b" font-size="12">Continuous mm-level stream</text>
</svg>
